data.gender_notes: Margo is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek Margarites, meaning pearl or gem of Mary. In Christian tradition, the name Margo is believed to represent the virtues of the Blessed Virgin Mary and the spiritual riches bestowed by her. The name Margo carries the meaning “Mary's gem” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Margo usually hope their child will grow to embody mary's gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of purity, faith, and devotion.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Margo total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
